hook: What if you could cut your coding costs in half? Grok 4.5 might just do that!
main_idea: Grok 4.5 offers a cost-effective solution for developers with its optimized performance for coding and AI tasks.
voiceover: What if you could cut your coding costs in half? Grok 4.5 might just do that! This latest release focuses on coding and AI agents, making it a game-changer for developers. It’s designed to handle complex programming tasks efficiently... and at a lower cost. For instance, Grok 4.5 charges just $2 per million input tokens, compared to $6 for OpenAI and $8 for Anthropic. Plus, it delivers results at 80 transactions per second, with double the efficiency of its competitors. This means you get faster, smarter outputs without breaking the bank. So, if you're looking to optimize your coding processes, give Grok 4.5 a try today!
